title: kErrorRelay error report (POST /api/report)
description: THE MASTER of the error-relay payload contract. Derived from kPayloadValidator.Rules (Functions/src/relay/kPayloadValidator.ts), which stays the authority at run time; Functions/src/tests/kRelayContract.test.ts fails when the two disagree. Four places are tested against this file: the relay, kCore.KFitReport (Admin/kReusableCoreTS), kPSErrorDetail.ToPayload (Admin/kPS/lib) and kErrorDetail.ToPayload (kSharedPy, which carries a committed copy at kshared/contract/error-report.schema.json because its public CI cannot see this repo). Change this file, the Rules table and the copy together. Non-standard keywords: x-lengthUnit says how maxLength is counted (the relay counts JavaScript String.length = UTF-16 code units, NOT code points as standard JSON Schema does); x-maxBodyBytes is the relay's limit on the whole request body in UTF-8 bytes (HTTP 413 above it). Missing optional fields are forwarded as "" / 0.
